annotations.title: TARIC / HS Code Customs Duty Calculator

description:
[Deterministic customs tariff calculation. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Validates 6, 8, and 10-digit TARIC / Combined Nomenclature codes, calculates CIF customs valuation (goods price + international freight/insurance to EU border), computes third-country import duty payable, and determines border VAT base.
Usage: Use this tool to calculate statutory customs duties and import VAT before shipping goods to the EU. For Incoterms cost splitting across parties, use 'incoterms_cost_allocator'.
Returns: JSON object with { taricCode: string, cifCustomsValueEur: number, dutyRatePercent: number, dutyPayableEur: number, importVatPayableEur: number, totalBorderTaxesEur: number }.

countryOfOriginIso2.description: Country of origin 2-letter ISO code (e.g. CN, US, GB)

customsValueEur.description: Invoice value of imported goods in EUR

dutyRateOverridePercent.description: Specific duty rate percentage if preferential tariff applies

freightAndInsuranceEur.description: Freight and insurance costs to EU border in EUR
